title: NEB Class 11 Mathematics — Calculus — 2020
subject: mathematics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: $\displaystyle \frac{d}{dx}\left[\log_{a}(\sin x)\right]$ is (a) $\frac{1}{\sin x\,\log_{e}a}$  (b) $\frac{\cot x}{\log_{e}a}$  (c) $\frac{\cos x}{\sin x}$  (d) $\tan x\log a$
questions.solution:
Using $\displaystyle\frac{d}{dx}\log_{a}u=\frac{u'}{u\log_{e}a}$ with $u=\sin x$, $u'=\cos x$:
$$\frac{d}{dx}\log_{a}(\sin x)=\frac{\cos x}{\sin x\cdot\log_{e}a}=\frac{\cot x}{\log_{e}a}$$

**Correct option: (b)**
questions.knowledgeNote: $\frac{d}{dx}\log_{a}x=\frac{1}{x\ln a}$ — the extra $\ln a$ in the denominator is easy to forget.
